شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

the sun burns but the mark remains

שׂ ר ט

to incise / to scratch / to cut into skin

we share the root of wounding
שמש gives light
שרט takes it in

you called the sun
i answer with the scar it leaves

what do you want written
on what surface
